title: Colored Tab color can't be selected
author: ValleBL
body_snippet:
**What happens** (and what you expected instead):
When choosing tab color, an exception is thrown

**Steps to reproduce:**

1. Select connection
2. Select Tab Color picker

**Version** (Help → About, or the nightly filename):
Latest Version v1.83.0 (Release 3659) Selfcontained

**Environment** (OS version; RDP/SSH/VNC target if relevant; anything unusual — locale, multi-monitor, VM):
AVD Jumphost
